posts.title: Wikid Update
posts.description: Nice thing on fedi this morning, a gentle query from BillSeitz asking how the WikidProject is going. I'm touched that somebody is even aware of the thing, let alone cares how it's going! I really ought to have written an update sooner, but I think part of me is ashamed at how slow progress has been.
